mapper.sql: s.*,owner.user_name owner_user_name,owner.nick_name owner_nick_name, acceptor.user_name acceptor_user_name,acceptor.nick_name acceptor_nick_name, reviewer.user_name reviewer_user_name,reviewer.nick_name reviewer_nick_name

m.*,s.scenario_code,s.scenario_name,s.status scenario_status, owner.user_name owner_user_name,owner.nick_name owner_nick_name, reviewer.user_name reviewer_user_name,reviewer.nick_name reviewer_nick_name
mapper.select: select from todo_acceptance_scenario s left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id=s.owner_user_id left join sys_user acceptor on acceptor.user_id=s.acceptor_user_id left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=s.reviewer_user_id order by s.scenario_code

select from todo_acceptance_scenario s left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id=s.owner_user_id left join sys_user acceptor on acceptor.user_id=s.acceptor_user_id left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=s.reviewer_user_id where s.scenario_id=#{scenarioId}
select scenario_id,scenario_code,status,version from todo_acceptance_scenario where scenario_code=#{scenarioCode}

select from todo_acceptance_ref_mapping m left join todo_acceptance_scenario s on s.scenario_id=m.scenario_id left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id=m.owner_user_id left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=m.reviewer_user_id where m.mapping_id=#{mappingId}
select user_id,user_name,nick_name,dept_id from sys_user where status='0' and del_flag='0' order by user_id
select user_id,user_name,nick_name,dept_id from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: insert into todo_acceptance_scenario (scenario_code,scenario_name,delivery_phase,business_path,preconditions_json,steps_json, expected_outcomes_json,dataset_ref,dataset_checksum,dataset_version,owner_user_id,acceptor_user_id, reviewer_user_id,due_at,status,conclusion,create_by) values (#{scenarioCode},#{scenarioName},'PHASE_ONE',#{businessPath},cast(#{preconditionsJson} as json), cast(#{stepsJson} as json),cast(#{expectedOutcomesJson} as json),#{datasetRef},#{datasetChecksum}, #{datasetVersion},#{ownerUserId},#{acceptorUserId},#{reviewerUserId},#{dueAt},#{status},#{conclusion},#{createBy})
mapper.update: update todo_acceptance_scenario set scenario_name=#{scenarioName},business_path=#{businessPath}, preconditions_json=cast(#{preconditionsJson} as json),steps_json=cast(#{stepsJson} as json), expected_outcomes_json=cast(#{expectedOutcomesJson} as json),dataset_ref=#{datasetRef}, dataset_checksum=#{datasetChecksum},dataset_version=#{datasetVersion},owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId}, acceptor_user_id=#{acceptorUserId},reviewer_user_id=#{reviewerUserId},due_at=#{dueAt},status=#{status}, conclusion=#{conclusion},reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_time=case when #{status} in ('APPROVED','REJECTED') then sysdate() else null end, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where scenario_id=#{scenarioId} and version=#{expectedVersion} and status=#{expectedStatus}

update todo_acceptance_ref_mapping set scenario_id=#{scenarioId},planned_test_ref=#{plannedTestRef}, evidence_note=#{evidenceNote},owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId},reviewer_user_id=#{reviewerUserId},due_at=#{dueAt}, status=#{status},conclusion=#{conclusion},reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_time=case when #{status} in ('APPROVED','REJECTED') then sysdate() else null end, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where mapping_id=#{mappingId} and version=#{expectedVersion} and status=#{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into todo_acceptance_action (action_id,entity_type,entity_id,action_type,action_status,request_fingerprint, operator_id,operator_name,operator_dept_id,payload_json) values (#{actionId},#{entityType},#{entityId},#{actionType},'CLAIMED',#{requestFingerprint}, #{operatorId},#{operatorName},#{operatorDeptId},cast(#{payloadJson} as json))
mapper.select: select * from todo_acceptance_action where action_id=#{actionId} for update
mapper.update: update todo_acceptance_action set action_status='APPLIED',result_entity_id=#{resultEntityId},completed_time=sysdate() where action_id=#{actionId} and request_fingerprint=#{requestFingerprint} and action_status='CLAIMED'
